verdict.rationale: Data residency or region selection is a fair question for a SaaS recruiting platform that holds candidate data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region, data residency options, or regional hosting. The 'any role or location' onboarding item refers to employee locations, not data storage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
